newsitems.title: Next Fest update: thank you, and here’s everything we fixed
newsitems.author: soundil.official
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone! 👋Next Fest has been a wild ride, and we’ve been reading every bug report, review and Discord message, even when we were too busy fixing things to reply. Thank you, seriously. Since the fest started we’ve pushed seven updates to the demo, almost all of them because of you.Here’s what changed:🔓 No more getting stuckThe office door no longer stays locked after punching inYou can’t get trapped in the office at the end of a shift anymoreThe upgrade form no longer disappears or gets stuck behind anythingRestarting from the menu now gives you a truly fresh runThe last shift is much clearer about what’s left to do🎮 ControlsFull controller support, menus and settings includedThe big lever: just hold right-click / RT, no more dragging your mouse off the deskDoors open with a clickA clear prompt when it’s time to leave for the day⚡ Runs betterMuch lighter on graphics cards by default, plus a frame limit optionFixed guide pages blending together on some PCsAlt-tab works properlyMotion blur can now be turned off➕ And a Wishlist on Steam button in the menus, in case you want to keep an eye on us 😄We’ve also read that some of you got a bit lost here and there, so we’ve made changes all over to keep things as clear as possible, and we’re not done yet. Please keep the feedback coming. As a solo developer, every single report genuinely helps.If you find anything else, the Report a Bug button in the pause menu goes straight to us, or come say hi on Discord. We’re listening, even when we’re quiet.See you at your station. 🖋️
